# interlens

> interlens is a harness for multi-agent (model-to-model) conversations with first-class interpretability — activation capture, steering, activation patching, and token logprobs — all hooked into the same generation path as real turns, scaling from one dialogue to thousands of checkpointed multi-GPU rollouts.

## Overview

- [Interlens: Framework for Multi-Agent Interaction and Interpretability](https://sidmb.com/docs/interlens)
